notes: The sea hull walk-on filmed frame by frame (journey=boat-walk-on/frames): the player stands on the pier at the stem of the lighterman's moored longboat (Lighter Flotilla, by day); the step stands still a second, then E walks aboard. The still second and the 3.6 s after E are the strip (framesSpanMs 4600), the whole walk-on: a level step over the stem onto the side deck and along it to the helm, no hop, no snap; the board step's state (boats.station against the player) proves the walk ends at the helm.

steps.name: board
steps.transition: on the pier at the stem, facing the hull, still for a second; then E: the player walks aboard to the helm
